description: This Java class 'EcuQueryImpl' implements the 'EcuQuery' interface and provides functionality for querying ECU data, including storing ECU response data, converting bytes to hex, and handling response setting and comparison operations.

classes.name: EcuQueryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the EcuQuery interface, managing ECU query data including address bytes, hexadecimal representation, and response value.

methods.name: EcuQueryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with ECU data, converting address to bytes and hex string.

methods.name: getLoggerData
methods.description: Returns the ECU data associated with this query.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves the address strings for the ECU.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array representation of the ECU address.

methods.name: getHex
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal string representation of the address bytes.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response value after converting response bytes using the ECU's converter.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the hexadecimal address representation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the hexadecimal address.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object, showing the hex address.
